newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks lose 2.34 pct at close on low volume.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks lose 2.34 pct at close on low volume.

text.p: Dhaka shares, battered by continuing sell-off by retail traders, slid for a sixth straight session amid agitation by traders in the kerb market, brokers said on Tuesday.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all share price index closed 55.73 points or 2.34 percent down at 2,319.64. Turnover declined to 18.9 million taka from Monday's 35.7 million. Of 82 traded issues, 73 lost and only nine gained.

Brokers said fresh agitation by kerb market traders who threatened to shut down floor trading from Sunday if price fall continue fuelled panic on the falling market. Singer Bangladesh shed 670 taka 12,732 and Monno Fabrics lost 10.88 to 206.96.
